name: What was Left Behind the Door
source:
Rory's childhood crush, Madison, suddenly moves into the apartment across from him. It's been 15 years since homophobia and bullying drove them apart; when their mutual friend flakes on dinner at Rory's place and leaves them stuck alone with each other, things get real awkward. 

When memory comes knocking, do you bury it deeper, or do you let it in? Both Madison and Rory must find the courage to open the door, and face what they left behind.

[From [url=https://bigflatcabbage.itch.io/what-was-left-behind-the-door]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗里儿时暗恋的麦迪逊突然搬进了他对面的公寓。距离同性恋恐惧症和欺凌行为导致他们疏远已经过去15年了。当他们共同的朋友在罗里家吃晚饭时突然失态，留下他们独自待在一起，事情变得非常尴尬。

当记忆来敲门时，你是把它埋得更深，还是让它进来？麦迪逊和罗里都必须鼓起勇气打开大门，面对他们留下的一切。

[来自[url=https://bigflatcabbage.itch.io/what-was-left-behind-the-door]itch.io[/url]]
